_comment: Extra apps installed into every new subsystem, pinned by APK and signing-certificate SHA-256; an entry with an `abi` is used only on a system that can run that CPU type, and the first listed CPU type wins (from the F-Droid index, cross-checked against each APK's own signature). F-Droid keeps only recent versions: if a download 404s, re-pin with: python3 scripts/preinstall-apps.py --pin <https APK url>. microG is installed by provision-microg.py, not listed here.
